$comment: TIER 1 — PRIMITIVES. Raw values with no meaning attached.
Blueprint §8.1: a component may ONLY reference tier 3. Nothing in the
application imports from this file; tier 2 maps these into meaning.
Colour is OKLCH throughout (§8.1): perceptually uniform lightness means a
programmatically generated dark theme is actually legible, and contrast
ratios behave predictably rather than needing per-colour hand-tuning.

color.$comment: Neutral is hue 250 at very low chroma — a hair cool, never clinical grey.
color.$comment_accent: Indigo. Interactive affordances only — never data (§8.2).
$comment_data: Categorical data-visualisation palette. ADOPTED, NOT AUTHORED.
Blueprint §8.9 designates the dataviz methodology as binding for this
palette specifically: 'its palette must be adopted rather than
reinvented.' These are its validated slot values, in its slot order.
An earlier revision authored a ramp here by hand — six hues spaced at
near-constant lightness. It looked principled and it failed the
validator in both modes: constant lightness is precisely what collapses
under colour-vision deficiency, because a CVD reader has lost the hue
axis and lightness is the only one left. Worst adjacent pair was ΔE 3.4
under deuteranopia against a target of 8.
Do not retune these by eye. Run:
Slot order is fixed and assigned by entity, never by rank (§8.2: colour
never encodes valence, and a filter that removes a series must not
$comment_data_light: The same eight hues stepped for the light surface — not the dark ramp
reused, and not an inversion of it (§8.7).
Three slots (aqua, yellow, magenta) sit below 3:1 on the light surface.
The validator flags this as a WARN with the relief rule attached: those
series must carry visible direct labels or the data table. §8.9(6)
already requires the table on every chart, so the relief is satisfied by
construction — but a chart that hides the table and relies on colour
alone for those three would be non-compliant.

$comment_space: 4px base grid (§8.4). Every margin, padding, and gap references a token; arbitrary values fail lint.
$comment_font: Two families (§8.3). Interface is Inter; long-form is a serif, because a visual mode-switch between recording data and writing reflectively is a genuine cognitive cue.

fontFamily.mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace

$comment_duration: Motion is functional (§8.6) — causality, continuity, state change. Never delight for its own sake.
$comment_size: 44px minimum touch target (§8.13) — non-negotiable for logging a set with sweaty hands.
